ZeroTier One 1.16.2 - independent official download
Copyright ZeroTier, Inc. and its contributors.

The default GameLink installer DOES NOT embed or redistribute the ZeroTier MSI.
When explicitly selected by the user, it downloads the unmodified official MSI
directly from ZeroTier, verifies the pinned SHA-256, and runs Windows Installer.
The user's use of ZeroTier remains subject to ZeroTier's applicable terms.
GameLink is not endorsed by or affiliated with ZeroTier, Inc.

IMPORTANT: The actual official 1.16.2 Windows x64 binary declares the
ZeroTier Source-Available License for Non-Commercial Use (nonfree/LICENSE.md).
Do not infer that this official Windows executable is MPL-only from the
release notes about default make builds. Windows Release project settings
include ZT_NONFREE_CONTROLLER=1 / ZT_NONFREE=1, and the MSI's extracted binary
contains the Source-Available declaration. Commercial use and redistribution
require the rights described by ZeroTier; none are granted by GameLink.
Offline embedding is disabled by default and requires confirmed redistribution
authorization. GameLink does not configure or use the bundled controller API.

MPL 2.0 applies to the agent source portions; nonfree portions have separate
terms. Original external dependency notices remain applicable.
Source: https://github.com/zerotier/ZeroTierOne/tree/1.16.2
Source archive: https://github.com/zerotier/ZeroTierOne/archive/refs/tags/1.16.2.zip
Desktop UI source: https://github.com/zerotier/DesktopUI
Original MPL: LICENSE-MPL-2.0.txt
Actual Windows binary declaration: LICENSE-SOURCE-AVAILABLE.md
Official download: https://download.zerotier.com/RELEASES/1.16.2/dist/ZeroTier%20One.msi
SHA-256: 42514072b0fe44b8f66e0395bcd23a0b1d1642c28ed00831f1527b2f41b14670

Removing GameLink does not remove the independently installed ZeroTier or its
identity/network data. GameLink does not import or replace planet/moon files.
These notices do not relicense GameLink or the separately distributed Qt DLLs.
